subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
Question 3
(a)  Apex Chemicals Ltd. processes a basic chemical raw material in 8
Department I, which yields two joint products, A and B, at the split-off point
in the ratio 60 40. The input-output ratio of Department I is 100: 90.

Product A can either be sold at split-off or further processed in Department
II to produce A-Prime. Department II is used exclusively for Product A, and
its input-output ratio is 100: 80.

Required:
(i)  Prepare a joint cost apportionment statement for Products A and B on
the basis of sales value at split-off point.
(ii)  Advise whether Product A should be sold at split-off or processed into
A-Prime, showing incremental revenue, incremental cost, and profit.
(8 Marks)
(b)  Alpha Limited uses Standard Costing System for manufacturing its single
product 'STAR'. The following data has been gathered from the cost records
of the company to compute various fixed overhead variances for a specific
period:
Number of budgeted working days

(i)  Fixed Overhead Expenditure Variance
(ii)  Fixed Overhead Volume Variance
(iii)  Fixed Overhead Calendar Variance
(iv)  Fixed Overhead Cost Variance
(Indicate the nature of variance Favourable (F) or Adverse (A))
(6 Marks)
